text: Separate the release pin from the api-reference hash: restore sha256 in .jayzee/engine/engine.yaml to its pre-1542dcb value, add api_reference_sha256 field in engine.yaml and engine INDEX, make update-engine-pin.py ignore the new field, witness the read path and sha256sum match, run npm run check and check-open-items, commit as lanmower no trailers, push origin main, confirm git log origin/main -1.

Cancel the stuck upstream git prompt (git ls-remote to git.jayzee.co waiting for username), confirm the working tree is clean, make one anonymous ls-remote attempt with GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 and 60s timeout, record output, and report.

const r = await gm.run_shell({ command: "ps -eo pid,ppid,etime,stat,args | grep -E 'git (ls-remote|fetch|pull|clone)|git-remote|git-credential|timeout 25 git' | grep -v grep; echo '--- git status:'; cd /workspace/cleetus && git status --short; echo '(end)'" });
return r.output;
